title: Water Horse : Legend Of The Deep
desc: Young Angus discovers a mysterious sea creature named Crusoe. As their friendship grows, he must protect the Water Horse from those who fear it.

title: Cruella
desc: Estella transforms into the rebellious Cruella, a daring fashion visionary. Her ambition and rivalry with the Baroness reshape her destiny.

title: Creation Of The Gods II: Demon Force
desc: Ji Fa and Jiang Ziya rally Xiqi's defenders and Kunlun immortals to protect their homeland from King Yin Shou's invading Shang army and demonic forces.

title: King Of Serpant
desc: When Chen Zheng and his friends go to King Serpent Island to collect data on snakes, they encounter evil snake catchers led by Jin Laosi. Will Chen Zheng be able to save the island and its snakes?

title: Thor: Ragnarok
desc: Thor is imprisoned on the planet Sakaar, and must race against time to return to Asgard and stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his world, at the hands of the powerful and ruthless villain Hela.

title: Blood Lake Attack Of The Killer Lampreys
desc: After a town is attacked by blood-sucking lampreys, an animal control specialist takes on the responsibility to bring the situation under control.

title: Kunlun Battle
desc: After the Kunlun gatekeeper is betrayed and ruined by his own people, his son joins forces with a shark man to fight their way back into Kunlun and avenge his father.

title: Mojin The Treasure Valley
desc: An adventurer explores an ancient valley seeking treasure and truth, uncovering secrets, battling legends, and testing loyalty in a mystical underground world.
